proposal.reason: Primary change is CE-backed host one-sided RMA (Put/Signal/WaitSignal), adding new CE launch, signaling/ack synchronization, and RMA execution paths. enqueue is additionally needed because new RMA operations are validated, converted to tasks, batched, scheduled into plans, and launched via group/planner flow. communicator is needed for host-RMA capability detection, numRmaCtx config parsing/defaulting/validation, and communicator init/finalize lifecycle integration. device-api is needed because the feature relies on symmetric window and LSA semantics, with substantive changes to window offset consistency handling and window-registration-triggered RMA CE initialization.
